properties.name: A real test run can be fed back by file, and a converter turns runner output into that form
properties.rationale: Step 4 part one on Anthony's ruling: real failures must flow before a doubt layer is worth building. A runner knows files, the design knows check ids, and nothing joined them — so on reflow2's own design no run had ever been fed back.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: reconcile_verification gains `observed_by_file` (resolved by DesignGraph::resolve_observed_files through a check's `location` or an IMPLEMENTS artifact's location; worst outcome per check; `unmapped_locations` in the reply). New tools/test_run_to_files.py converts cargo-test text (CI colour codes stripped), JUnit XML and python script exit codes; its own net is a new CI gate.
